title: BenchmarkIndex
description: index.json: what the reports hold. Ids are stable slugs, and each id a record names must be one the index defines; a report's commit must be one of its group's. Each report is the file at `reports[].path`, in the format `reports[].format` names.

format_version.description: Raised for any change but an added optional field, which readers ignore.

groups.description: What the page groups benchmarks by, such as the package they time.

label.description: A name to show; without it, show the name.

description.description: One line on what sets the group apart, such as how its packages are installed.

links.description: More pages about what the group names, such as its source or changelog.

measures.description: The id is the measure's key in reports.

statistic.description: How a value sums up its samples, such as median or max.

bounds.description: What a metric's lower and upper values are, in words to show, such as "the middle half of the samples".

noise.description: How far a value may move as noise, as the release changes count it: spreads times its spread ((upper - lower) / value), at least floor. A value without bounds gets floor.

machines.description: Results from two machines are never pooled.

environments.description: What a case ran in, such as a Python version and its packages.

label.description: A short name to show, such as the solver it runs; without it, show a short form of the name.

description.description: A line on what the environment runs, shown under the chart when it is on it.

url.description: Where to read about what the label names.

benchmarks.description: One timed function and the parameter axes it runs over.

label.description: A short name to show; without it, show a readable form of the name.

codspeed.description: Its first case on CodSpeed, where the same benchmark runs under instruction counting.

measures.description: The measure ids its metrics use.

label.description: The parameter's name to show; without it, show the name.

values.description: As cases give them, in display order.

labels.description: How to show each value; without it, show the values.

notes.description: What each value means, in the order of values; empty where there is none.

links.description: Where to read about each value, in the order of values; empty where there is none.

cases.description: One benchmark at one parameter set in one environment: one line on a chart. The id is its key in reports.

params.description: One value per axis of the benchmark, in the same order.

commits.description: Commits with results, oldest first within a group.

release.description: The name to show if the commit is a release, such as its tag; not an id.

reports.description: One file per commit, group and machine.

path.description: Relative to index.json, never above it.

format.description: Format and version, such as bmf/v0. Readers skip formats they don't know.

changes.description: Where a series moved, found before the data was written, oldest first within a series. A series is one case on one machine in one measure.

commit.description: The first commit at the new level.

baseline.description: The commit it is compared with.

ratio.description: The new level over the old: the two values for release, the two means for change-point.

method.description: release: two releases in a row, against the case's noise. change-point: a shift in the series' mean.

threshold.description: release only: how far the ratio could move from 1 as noise.

pvalue.description: change-point only: the significance test's p-value.

findings.description: What the histories show, in the order to show them, each with the view that shows it.

text.description: One or two sentences with the numbers.

params.description: The value to show, as a label, for each axis of the benchmark that the view fixes; in axis order, empty to keep the default.

profile.description: A profile of the case that explains the finding.

story.description: The slug of the story that tells this finding in full, at /stories/<slug>/.
